hierarchical_model.quadrature_method: adaptive Gauss-Hermite centered at target-specific conditional posterior modes; changed after nonadaptive integration failed the prespecified stability gate
hierarchical_model.random_effects: independent target intercepts and slopes with partial pooling
hierarchical_model.fallback: random intercept plus common slope only for convergence or identifiability failure
hierarchical_model.uncertainty: conditional target posteriors from Gauss-Hermite quadrature and hyperparameter observed-information approximation
